snippet.title: Pencil!: Learn to Draw x Walkabout Mini Golf - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Pencil!: Learn to Draw x Walkabout Mini Golf trailer to see the collaboration as Walkabout Mini Golf celebrates the release of its Alice in Wonderland course. Step through the looking glass with a brand-new Wonderland Lesson Pack in Pencil, featuring whimsical drawings inspired by the world of Alice — all lovingly created by Walkabout Mini Golf’s legendary artist, Don Carson. Additionally, you can design your own mini golf course inside Pencil’s Free Draw Mode, using a playful collection of authentic Walkabout Mini Golf–inspired set pieces. Build your dream course, sketch your favorite scenes, and bring a little bit of Wonderland magic to life. The Alice's Adventure in Wonderland lesson pack is available now in Pencil!: Learn to Draw.
